hero_prop_criteria.center_of_focus: The story, a shot or a character's attention centres on the object.
hero_prop_criteria.high_frequency: The object is present in more than one scene/act.
hero_prop_criteria.transfer: The object passes between two characters.

scenes.heading: EXT. SABA ELIOR’S COURTYARD — LATE MORNING

hero_props.name: Yonah’s small lunch of five barley loaves and two fish
hero_props.description: Yonah’s bundled lunch: five barley loaves and two fish. After it is given, the same lunch changes form through the miracle into multiplied bread and fish, then leftover pieces gathered afterward.
hero_props.reason: This is the central miracle prop: Yonah’s small gift drives the feeding of the crowd, is passed to Andrew and Jesus, multiplies, and becomes the lesson Miri applies to her cakes.

hero_props.name: Cloth bundle of three honey-date cakes
hero_props.description: Miri’s cloth-wrapped set of three honey-date cakes. They are guarded at first, then opened and divided; by Scene 15 the same set changes form into shared whole cakes, halves, small pieces, and crumbs.
hero_props.reason: The cakes embody Miri’s fear of not having enough and her eventual generosity. They recur across the village scenes and are finally given to Tav and Nim.

hero_props.name: Linen basket and folded linen
hero_props.description: The basket of folded linen and sleeve cloth Ima sends with Miri to Saba. It also hides the cake bundle and later becomes Nim’s resting place.
hero_props.reason: The linen basket motivates Miri’s errand to Saba, is handed from Ima to Miri and the linen is delivered to Saba, and it recurs through the frame story.

hero_props.name: Miracle baskets
hero_props.description: The baskets used during the feeding miracle to hold, distribute, and gather the multiplied bread and fish. They are distinct from Miri’s linen basket and culminate as twelve full baskets of leftovers.
hero_props.reason: The baskets make the miracle visible: they carry the abundance, pass through many hands, and become the proof that nothing is lost.

hero_props.name: Small scroll of the feeding story
hero_props.description: Saba’s magical small scroll tied with a barley-colored cord and marked with a loaf-and-fish seal. It opens the story-world and later returns to its shelf glowing softly.
hero_props.reason: The scroll is the portal and storytelling device that brings Miri into the feeding miracle, then remains as the tangible record of the story.

hero_props.name: Tav’s toy cart and repair peg
hero_props.description: Tav’s small toy cart with a loose wheel. It appears broken when Miri first passes him, then becomes the object she helps repair after sharing the cakes; Nim contributes a small peg to fix it.
hero_props.reason: The cart marks Tav’s need and becomes Miri’s practical act of generosity after the lesson. It appears in both the setup and resolution, and the peg is moved from Nim to Miri to complete the repair.
